## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can set archive exclusions through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by basename and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It documents the flag and adds tests for parsing, filtering, and archive contents.
